evidence.title: GitHub - janglad/shadcn-dropzone: A dropzone component built in the style of Shadcn using react-dropzone · GitHub

name: shadcn-dropzone
summary: Accessible file-upload dropzone component in shadcn style, built on react-dropzone.
description: A dropzone file-upload component styled like shadcn/ui, using the useDropzone hook from react-dropzone and aiming to be fully accessible. Install it with the shadcn CLI through its registry URL or copy the component file; React Hook Form integration is still on the todo list.
contains: one dropzone component built on react-dropzone's useDropzone hook
installs with the shadcn CLI from the dropzone.json registry URL
React Hook Form integration on the todo list
